comment: Curated winetricks verbs DeckWrench offers through protontricks. Each id is a winetricks verb; only verbs that are safe to run in a Proton prefix are listed.

verbs.label: Visual C++ 2015-2022
verbs.help: Microsoft's C++ runtime most current games need (also covers 2015, 2017 and 2019).

verbs.label: Visual C++ 2013
verbs.help: Older C++ runtime used by many 2013-2016 games and launchers.

verbs.label: Visual C++ 2012
verbs.help: C++ runtime for some 2012-2014 games.

verbs.label: Visual C++ 2010
verbs.help: C++ runtime for many 2010-2013 games and mod tools.

verbs.label: Visual C++ 2008
verbs.help: C++ runtime for older games.

verbs.label: Visual C++ 2005
verbs.help: C++ runtime for games from the mid 2000s.

verbs.label: .NET Framework 4.8
verbs.help: Needed by many mod managers, launchers and tools. Takes several minutes to install.

verbs.label: .NET Framework 4.7.2
verbs.help: For tools that ask for exactly 4.7.2.

verbs.label: .NET Framework 4.0
verbs.help: For older launchers and tools.

verbs.label: .NET Framework 3.5
verbs.help: For old XNA games and tools. Slow to install.

verbs.label: .NET Desktop Runtime 6
verbs.help: For modern .NET apps (mod tools, launchers) built on .NET 6.

verbs.label: .NET Desktop Runtime 8
verbs.help: For modern .NET apps built on .NET 8.

verbs.label: XNA Framework 4.0
verbs.help: For indie games built on XNA (Terraria-era).

verbs.label: PhysX
verbs.help: NVIDIA PhysX system software, for games that refuse to start without it.

verbs.label: DirectX 9 extras (d3dx9)
verbs.help: The d3dx9_*.dll helper libraries older DirectX 9 games ship without.

verbs.label: D3D shader compiler 47
verbs.help: Microsoft's shader compiler; fixes some games and launchers that build shaders at start.

verbs.label: D3D shader compiler 43
verbs.help: The older shader compiler some DirectX 9-11 games need.

verbs.label: XACT (32-bit)
verbs.help: Microsoft's XACT audio libraries; fixes missing sound in some older games.

verbs.label: XACT (64-bit)
verbs.help: 64-bit XACT audio libraries.

verbs.label: Microsoft core fonts
verbs.help: Arial, Times New Roman, Verdana and friends; fixes missing or boxy text in launchers.

verbs.label: Tahoma
verbs.help: A font some older launchers and installers expect.

verbs.label: CJK fonts
verbs.help: Chinese, Japanese and Korean fonts, for games showing boxes instead of text.

verbs.label: Report Windows 10
verbs.help: Makes the prefix report Windows 10 (Proton's default for most games).

verbs.label: Report Windows 7
verbs.help: For old launchers that refuse newer Windows versions.

verbs.label: Smooth fonts (subpixel)
verbs.help: Turns on ClearType-style font smoothing in launchers.
